blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Big Yellow Boxing Gym’s Mark Anthony Sarino will face John Ver Espra in the main event of “Bakbakan Otso” on Saturday, October 24 in the Barangay Mantija Sports Complex in Danao City, Cebu. Promoted by Big Yellow Boxing Promotions, the fight card will feature four of the stable’s promising boxers, led by Sarino and Espra. The two will dispute the Visayas Professional Boxing Association (Visproba) bantamweight title over eight rounds. Sarino is one of Big Yellow’s rising prospects alongside Arlando Senoc.
